description: Upload a local dotenv file (.env, .env.local, .env.production, ...) to a project's environment in one atomic change, without the values entering this conversation: the MCP server reads the file itself and the result lists names only. Names the platform sets itself (PORT, HOSTNAME, HOME, PATH, RIGHTSIDE_*, POLIGON_*, and DATABASE_URL when the project has a RightSide database) are skipped and listed in `skipped`. Use secret: true for API keys and credentials. Changes take effect on the next deploy, or immediately with apply: true; if applying fails the error says `envSaved: true`. On failure, follow error.details.retry: idempotencyKey "reuse" means the outcome is unknown, so call again with the same idempotencyKey (it resumes or replays the original request instead of starting a second release); "new" means the release already failed, so call again without idempotencyKey or with a new one (the old key only replays that failure); waitFirst means call project_status until no operation is running before retrying.

apply.description: Serve the new environment now by restarting the live release. Default: next deploy.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this exact value when retrying. Generated when omitted.

path.description: Absolute path to the dotenv file on this machine.

secret.description: Store every imported value as a write-only secret. Default false keeps an existing variable's flag.

name: import_env
